description: List legislative committees for a US state, optionally filtered by chamber (upper/lower) or type (committee/subcommittee). Returns committee name, chamber, jurisdiction, and parent committee for subcommittees. Useful for identifying which committee oversees a policy area or finding where a bill is assigned. Use jurisdiction codes such as "ca", "tx", "ny".

chamber.description: Filter by chamber (e.g. "upper" for Senate, "lower" for House/Assembly, "legislature" for joint committees).

jurisdiction.description: State or jurisdiction abbreviation to list committees for (e.g. "ca", "tx", "ny").

per_page.description: Number of results per page (1–50, default 20).

name: openstates.legislature.committees

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.
